candidates.title: Arm Circle
candidates.description:
1. Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart. Extend your arms out to the sides parallel to the ground, forming a "T" shape.

2. Begin making circular motions with your arms. You can start with small circles and gradually increase the size as you feel more comfortable. Rotate your arms forward in a circular motion.

3. Focus on controlled and smooth movements. Feel the muscles around your shoulders and upper arms engaging.

4. After completing forward circles, reverse the direction and start making circles in the backward direction. Again, start with small circles and gradually increase the size.

5. Keep your spine straight, and engage your core muscles for stability. Relax your neck and shoulders, allowing the movement to come from your shoulder joints.

6. Perform arm circles at a controlled and comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining proper form and feeling the muscles working.

7. You can perform arm circles for a specific duration, such as 30 seconds to 1 minute, or for a certain number of repetitions.
